media.title: No media yet
media.body: Drop video, audio or images here, or press Ctrl+I to import.

audio.title: No audio yet
audio.body: Music, sound effects and voiceovers appear here. Import a file or record a voiceover.

text.title: Text styles
text.body: Titles, lower thirds and subtitles appear here once the text library is installed.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.body: Stickers and shapes you add to a project appear here.

effects.title: Effects
effects.body: Effects you can apply to a clip appear here, grouped by what they change.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.body: Transitions between two clips appear here. Select a cut on the timeline to apply one.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Color looks and filters appear here, with a strength slider in the inspector.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Project templates and compositions appear here. Start from one to skip the setup.

captions.title: Captions
captions.body: Generate captions from speech or import an SRT file. Caption styles appear here.

ai-studio.title: AI Studio
ai-studio.body: Generate clips, images and voices. Each action shows its cost and model before it runs.

drop.title: Drop to import
drop.body: Release to add the files to this project.

import.desktopOnly: Importing files needs the Cutweave desktop app.

reason.unsupported: This file has no video or audio Cutweave can play. Try another file.
reason.io: The file could not be read. Check its permissions and try again.
reason.invalid: The file's details are not usable. Try exporting it again from its source.
reason.notFound: The file is missing. Check that it still exists and try again.
reason.timedOut: Reading the file took too long. Try again, or copy it to a local drive.

remove.confirmBody: {{count}} clips on the timeline use it.
remove.confirmNote: The engine only removes media that no clip uses. If it refuses, delete those clips first. The file on disk is never touched.

preview.emptyBody: Add a clip to the timeline and the frame at the playhead shows here.
preview.canvasLabel: Preview of the frame at the playhead

reduced.forced: CUTWEAVE_PREVIEW=jpeg is set, so frames arrive as still images at up to 15 fps.
reduced.webgpu: WebGPU is not available here, so frames arrive as still images at up to 15 fps.
reduced.noAddon: The fast preview bridge did not load, so frames arrive as still images at up to 15 fps.
reduced.noRing: This engine does not stream preview frames, so they arrive as still images at up to 15 fps.
reduced.ring: The preview stream stopped, so frames arrive as still images at up to 15 fps.

preview.noFramesBody: The engine sent no frame for the playhead. You can still edit and move the playhead.

transport.label: Transport
transport.unsupported: This engine can't play the timeline yet. You can still edit and move the playhead.

inspector.emptyBody: Select a clip on the timeline to edit its position, scale, opacity and effects.
inspector.multiple: {{count}} clips selected. Mixed values stay as they are until you change them.
inspector.multipleTime: Select one clip to change its start or duration.

time.invalid: Not a time. Try 00:00:02:00, 2.5s or f:60.
time.needsRate: This clip's sequence has no frame rate yet. Use seconds, like 2.5s.
time.range: That time is out of range.
time.frames: That frame does not exist at this frame rate.

media.title: Media
media.placeholder: Placeholder data. The FFmpeg backend is not installed, so this probe is made up.

projectUi.readOnlyBody: This project was saved by a newer version of Cutweave, so editing is off. Use Save as to keep an editable copy.

new.title: New project
new.name: Name
new.hint: Cutweave creates a folder named {{name}} there and saves the project in it.

errors.nameInvalid: Names cannot contain / \ : * ? " < > | or start or end with a dot.
errors.locationMissing: Choose the folder to create it in.

unsaved.title: Save changes to {{name}}?
unsaved.body: You have unsaved changes. If you discard them, they stay in the recovery journal and can be offered the next time you open this project.

recovery.title: Restore unsaved changes?
recovery.body: Cutweave closed before {{name}} was saved. {{count}} edits from {{time}} can be restored.
recovery.bodyOne: Cutweave closed before {{name}} was saved. 1 edit from {{time}} can be restored.
recovery.damaged: The journal ends with a damaged entry. Everything before it can be restored.
recovery.restoreCount: Restore unsaved changes ({{count}} edits, last at {{time}})
recovery.note: Discard keeps the project as you last saved it. The discarded edits are kept in the project's backups folder.

reason.locked: It is open in another Cutweave window. Close it there, then try again.
reason.missing: Cutweave could not find that project. Choose the project folder or its .cutweave file.
reason.exists: That folder already holds a project. Choose another name or location.
reason.readOnly: This project is read-only. Use Save as to keep an editable copy.

recovered.title: Changes restored
recovered.body: {{count}} unsaved edits are back. They are not saved to the project file yet.

projectUi.missingMedia: {{count}} media files are offline. Relink them to keep editing.
projectUi.missingMediaOne: 1 media file is offline. Relink it to keep editing.
projectUi.migrated: {{name}} was converted from format {{from}}. Saving writes the new format.
projectUi.autosaveFailed: {{message}} Save the project yourself, or free up disk space.

timeline.emptyBody: Drag a clip from Media onto a track to start cutting.

reason.overlap: It would overlap another clip on that track. Drop it on a free spot.
reason.locked: The track is locked. Unlock it to edit its clips.
reason.inGesture: Someone else is editing this clip right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.changed: The project changed while you were editing. Try again.
reason.interrupted: The edit was interrupted and undone. Try again.

restarted.damaged: The journal ended with a damaged entry; everything before it is back.
restarted.untitled: Changes to the untitled project were not kept. Save it to a project folder so a restart can restore them.

blocked.failedBody: Editing is paused. Choose Restart in the engine dialog to continue, or quit Cutweave. Changes to a saved project are kept in its journal.
blocked.mismatchTitle: This editor does not match the engine
blocked.mismatchBody: Editing is off so nothing changes by mistake. Install matching versions of Cutweave and its engine. Engine {{version}}.
